title: Client account search and management
summary: Staff can search public client accounts on the Clients page. Staff-side accounts are not listed.
changes: Staff, Clients has a search box. Two or more characters match name, email, username or phone, and each result opens the client profile.
Staff-side accounts are left out of that search.
New permissions staff.clients.search, staff.clients.manage and staff.clients.sensitive are on the View accounts and Manage accounts packs.
version_rationale: Patch number: the v0.68.0 tag was created before VERSION was bumped and cannot be moved, so this ships the merged client search as v0.68.1.
validation: Client search feature test on the local Herd PHPUnit run.
known_limitations: Filters, suspend, merge, GDPR export and the account-history tab are not in this release.
Finding a client from a pet, microchip, ticket or case is not in this release.
rollback: Redeploy the v0.67.1 tag. The search page and new permissions are additive.
provenance: Issue #606 and pull requests #859 and #860. The v0.68.0 tag was not published.
